title: occ/{occ}/origin payload
description: UPSERT payload of occ/{occ}/origin, written by the import with a copy it creates: the export row the copy came from. The import finds its copies again through these. Serialized, at most 135 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it. Server-owned: a Push of this key is REJECTED facet_key_not_user_owned.

site.description: The source's site key, e.g. mfc.

native_id.description: The source's id for the row's item, verbatim.

ordinal.description: Which of the row's Count copies, 1 to 99.
